opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution, and not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain valid for the course, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering tuition fees for individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, studying for a first degree (or in limited cases a second degree) at a Scottish higher education institution.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants

amount.raw: funding is capped at a maximum of £5,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduates in Scotland from low-income Scottish households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, who have applied for or secured a place on an eligible taught or research master's programme at a Scottish higher education institution beginning in 2026/27.
opportunities.summary: New grant scheme launched in 2026/27 to help graduates in Scotland who otherwise couldn't afford it meet the costs of postgraduate study, supporting full-time or part-time taught or research master's degrees at Scottish universities. Applications opened 1 May 2026.
